programs.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble
programs.desc: The girl next door makes a teen born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.

programs.title: Ozzy
programs.desc: When his family goes on vacation, a young dog finds himself at a dog prison where he must escape with the help of his new friends.

programs.title: Captain Sharky
programs.desc: Pint-sized swashbuckler Captain Sharky thinks he's the most dangerous pirate on the Seven Seas. To prove his bravery, he sets sail with Mikey, a well-behaved boy whose life Sharky has turned upside down, and Bonnie, a trouble-shooting girl who tends to assume command in every situation. This motley crew sails for big adventures as they thwart the plans of The Admiral and Old Bill the Pirate.

programs.title: Legends of Oz: Dorothy's Return
programs.desc: Legends of Oz: Dorothy’s Return finds Dorothy waking up to a devastated post-tornado Kansas. She must rush back to Oz to save her old friends the Scarecrow, the Tin Man, the Cowardly Lion, Glinda the Good Witch and the entire Land of Oz from the devious brother of the Wicked Witch of the West – The Jester. With Dorothy as their only hope to restore order and happiness to Emerald City, she must battle through a magical journey with Toto at her side and some new friends to help her find her way.

programs.title: Champagne Charlie
programs.desc: This is the tale of Charles Heidsieck who introduced Champagne to the American market right before the Civil War. Though a hesitant French spy, he ends up caught and held in a Union prison. The story also features two love stories (since, well, he's French) and some conflicts with his uncle over who gets to run the family vineyard. The tension comes from the fact that his dad married his mom, who was also his uncle's love interest.

programs.title: King Solomon's Mines 1
programs.desc: The first in a Double Bill:  Safari hunter, Allan Quartermain, heads into Africa in order to rescue a man, who had disappeared while searching for the fabled lost gold mines of King Solomon.

programs.title: King Solomon's Mines 2
programs.desc: Part 2 of a Double Bill:  Legends of countless riches lie ahead as Quartermain and his crew of explorers encounter thrilling twists and turns deep down in King Solomon's mines.

programs.title: Krakatoa: East of Java
programs.desc: In 1883, ship captain Hanson plans a shipwreck salvage mission in The Dutch East Indies to retrieve a cargo of pearls but an unexpected volcano eruption and a state-ordered transport of convicts upset his plans.

programs.title: Casablanca Express
programs.desc: In 1942, a commando is assigned to protect Winston Churchill when it is learned that the Nazis are plotting to kidnap him.

programs.title: Sirens
programs.desc: When a painting is termed blasphemous, a young minister and his wife visit the artist... and the three sexually playful models living with him.

programs.title: Fist of Fury
programs.desc: A young man is out to get revenge for the death of his mentor. The story kicks off with Ho Yuan-chia's passing. He was a famous Chinese hero known for beating Russia's top wrestler and Japan's bushido masters. He got poisoned, but by who? And why? No one knows for sure, and there's a lot of guessing going on.
